question: From where is all worshipped by one effort and where is support-power placed?
premises: From the empty base all is worshipped by one effort.
It is placed four fingers below the navel.
inference: A single effort from the empty base worships all, while support-power is installed below the navel.
uncertainties: śūnyādhiṣṭhānataḥ may refer to a subtle-body locus.
plain_english: From the empty base all is worshipped by one effort; but place the support-power four fingers below the navel.
